categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches contrib/guix manifests and guix-build scripts under the Build system label.
categories.rationale: Extracting the Guix Linux toolchain into a reusable module enables static release builds and binary size optimizations. The author notes this is 'a prerequisite for static release builds (#25573)' and enables changes like '#36193 (building a more stripped down libstdc++, and shipping smaller binaries).'

categories.evidence: Guix scripts and manifests are release and build infrastructure, which the tools category explicitly delegates to build.
categories.rationale: Guix build definitions and guix-build runner scripts belong under Build and CI rather than Tools and scripts.
